title: Diagnostic sandbox: incident runbook (mini-playbook)
content:
Purpose:
Quick, portable runbook for debugging SDK integration incidents in the local sandbox or short-lived repro clusters. This is intentionally compact — we want something an engineer can glance at during pager or when a customer hits a failure during onboarding.

Audience:
- SDK maintainers, solutions engineers, on-call devs helping customers through first integration.

When to use:
- Customer reports errors during first-run (init/auth, model selection, streaming failures)
- Flaky tokenization, unusual latency spikes, or inconsistent outputs vs production

Quick checklist (first 8 minutes):
1) Confirm version: `redwood-sdk --version` or check package.json/pyproject. Note any pinned adapters.
2) Check customer-side keys & region: verify auth error vs 401s in logs.
3) Reproduce in hermetic sandbox: `make sandbox-up && ./scripts/run-sample --sample small-chat` (node & py samplers included).
4) Capture a failing trace: enable DEBUG trace header: `X-RW-Debug: trace` and produce 2 request IDs. Grab tracer output + timestamp.
5) Compare local vs hosted: run same prompt to hosted API and to local stub. If mismatch, save both responses.

Common failure signatures & heuristics:
- "partial stream then EOF": likely streaming connection closed by client or reverse-proxy idle timeout. Check nginx/gateway timeouts and SDK stream keepalive config.
- "rapid token slowdown": KV cache thrash or large context (truncate policy mismatch). Check sequence_length histogram in traces.
- "different completions": prompt preamble or role tokens being mutated by client-side templating; inspect assembled payload in logs.
- "403 on embeddings": customer KMS or key scoping issue; confirm key audience scope and region.

Sandbox reproduction tips:
- Use `sandbox/state-reset.sh` before each run. Keep a clean kv-cache snapshot under /tmp/rw-kv-<ts>.
- For streaming issues, run `ncat -l 8081` to accept raw events and watch chunk timing.
- Use `pytest -k 'smoke or stream' -q` to run minimal integration tests that exercise the SDK wire protocol.

Telemetry knobs to inspect quickly:
- request.latency (p50/p95/p99), request.size_tokens, reply.stream_chunk_count
- tracer.request_id, tracer.route, host_kernel_ms, kv_cache_hit_ratio
- client.telemetry.sdk_version, client.network.rtt_ms

Repro commands (examples):
- curl sample (short):
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -H "X-RW-Debug: trace" \n    -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16}' \n    https://sandbox.redwood.local/v1/generate | jq .

- Node quick: `node examples/quickstream.js --key $TEST_KEY --prompt "summarize: foo"`
- Python quick: `PYTHONPATH=./python-sdk python -m examples.stream_demo --key $K`

Rollout gating checklist (if root cause is SDK change):
- reproduce locally with same package version and sample app
- write minimal failing unit/integration test and add to sdk-smoke CI
- hold canary: no rollout until 2x green canary runs for 24h
- document regression in release notes and link to PR

Postmortem stub (fill after incident):
- Incident start/stop times:
- Impacted customers & severity:
- Root cause summary (one-sentence):
- Corrective actions taken (code/config/ops):
- Follow-ups & owners with due dates:

Known gaps / open questions:
- We don't have a stable small-context synthetic that exercises quantized kernels — need one (tracked JIRA-ENG-2104).
- Better default timeouts for SDK streaming across proxies (proposal in PR 314).

Short TODOs (near term):
- [ ] Add a `--trace-output` flag to the python example to write structured traces to /tmp (owner: Liam) due 2025-02-05
- [ ] Add kv-cache snapshot helper to sandbox images (owner: Maya) due 2025-02-12
- [ ] Bake a minimal failing case into sdk-smoke CI (owner: Owen) due 2025-02-20

Notes to self:
- Keep steps minimal during pager; if uncertain, escalate to eng-serving-runtime on-call. Save all artifacts under /var/tmp/rw-dbg-<request_id>.

References & links:
- sandbox ops notes (confluence:devexp-sandbox-ops)
- Github repro for streaming timeout PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-stubs/pull/314
- JIRA-ENG-1782 (customer onboarding failure triage)

End.
